summary: A neighbor comes to the door with a clipboard and a petition and asks for a signature.
realLife: Opponents of a development gathered petition signatures from residents; one mayor argued many people sign without being fully informed.
sources: WSOC-TV, hundreds at Weddington town hearing: https://www.wsoctv.com/news/local/development-debate-brings-hundreds-raucous-weddington-town-meeting/BATFRWXP6NCZFBC2CEMHZBD7IY
inGame: a cause-shared record between the player and the neighbor (topic a policy question, budget line or illness) leading to an invitation to a posted meeting of the town's body; needs: a petition record with signers

turns.summary: You sign after asking what the petition really changes.
turns.writesBack: tie warms; you are on the signer list

turns.summary: You sign quickly without reading, to end the conversation.
turns.writesBack: signature recorded; later regret if wrong

turns.summary: You say you want to read more first and keep the clipboard visit short.
turns.writesBack: neighbor remembers the refusal; tie cools
